faq.q2: do payments go through the platform?
faq.a2: not yet, brands and creators agree directly.

form.avatarHint: A square photo where your face is clear.
form.handleHint: Your profile link: lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore.
form.bioHint: What you create, for whom, what makes you different.
form.bioPh: Lifestyle and beauty creator from Baku…
form.barterHint: Collaborate in exchange for a product or service instead of money.
form.socialsHint: Enter your username and press “Connect account”. We take followers and views from your account automatically.
form.contactsHint: Your contacts stay private. Only the brand of a listing you apply to can see them.
form.pricesHint: Ballpark price per post in AZN. Leave empty to show “negotiable”.

crop.title: Adjust your photo
crop.hint: Drag and zoom. Whatever is inside the circle becomes your profile photo.

form.moreNetworksSoon: TikTok and YouTube are coming soon. For now, add your Instagram account.
form.connecting: Checking the account. This can take up to 30 seconds.
form.termsHint: Brands will see on your profile how you work. If you leave both unchecked, your profile will show “Paid only”.
form.repostHint: Instead of payment, the brand shares your Reel or story on its own page.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Add links to your best work. Brands decide faster when you have 3 or more.
portfolio.urlHint: Link to an Instagram post or Reel. For Reels, we’ll check views and likes automatically.
portfolio.notYours: This post belongs to @{owner}. Numbers are shown only for your own posts.
